phase: Phase 8 — Cross-Scene Sanity Check and First Full-Shot Render
purpose: Determine whether frozen Model E luminance plus ratio scaling plus frozen MMR-1 chroma regrading, fitted once from four representative full-resolution paired frames with 5,000 paired rows per training frame, is practically stable across automatically bounded real shots and can render a complete bounded Matrix shot without per-frame fitting.

frozen_transform.name: Model E luminance + ratio scaling + frozen MMR-1 chroma regrading
frozen_transform.final_luminance_rule: Reimpose the Model-E target luminance after the frozen MMR-1 ICtCp inverse.

automatic_candidate_selection.source_pool: All existing P2.32 selected_cases for The Matrix and BR2049; no source-duration scan and no new candidate generation.

local_shot_grouping.implementation: Exact reused Phase 6 HDR-only bounded discovery.

selection_order.matrix: Use Matrix 08 when it resolves, then add the first non-overlapping locally resolved Matrix temporal strata in ascending P2.32 selection_index until three total shots are selected. Selection is independent of fit metrics.
selection_order.br2049: Use the first locally resolved BR2049 temporal stratum in ascending P2.32 selection_index. Its result remains conditional when geometry confidence is below 0.95.
selection_order.shortfall: Record INSUFFICIENT_ELIGIBLE_SHOTS; do not relax any gate or substitute manually chosen frames.

sampling.common_grid_rule: Use every case's preserved P2.32 overlap as the full-resolution coordinate universe. Samples are deterministic rows from the unchanged block partition ((y//80+x//120)%5)==0 and its complement, with no post-geometry image downsampling and no independent SDR/HDR selection.
sampling.h0_fit_rule: Fit Model E only from the same 5,000 paired full-resolution common-grid luminance rows from each of the four training frames.
sampling.temporal_holdout_rule: The 90% frame is excluded from H0 fit, MMR-1 ridge fit, and lambda selection; apply the single chosen transform to it only after fitting.

validation.compare: frozen MMR-1 versus the same-shot Model E ratio-scaled H0 baseline in full overlap
validation.full_shot_render_gate: Only selected Matrix shots whose five-frame result satisfies numerical output requirements are rendered. Visual artifacts are recorded for human review, never hidden or auto-corrected.
validation.br2049_interpretation: Transformation-fidelity/near-identity only; do not judge it as an equal creative-regrading test. Geometry confidence below 0.95 makes it conditional/non-confirmatory.

render.render_interval: Every frame in the automatically resolved bounded local shot interval, never a partial interval.
render.transform_application: One persisted H0 parameter set plus one persisted frozen MMR-1 coefficient matrix per shot; no per-frame fitting.
render.composition: Generated full SDR Open Matte regrade with the original HDR target inserted unmodified in the preserved P2.32 overlap rectangle; no feathering or scene-specific composition adjustment.
render.output_encoding: Lossless FFV1 Matroska, 16-bit RGB PQ code values with BT.2020/SMPTE2084 tags.
render.streaming_equivalence: Before application, compare first and final streamed raw HDR/OM frames against independent exact Phase-6-style RGB48LE extraction. Abort that render if either byte hash differs.

hard_stop: After automatic candidate screening, fixed-configuration validations, up to three Matrix bounded full-shot renders, and the final report, stop. Do not start another model/sampling experiment or a full-film process.
